title: Linux package manifest
description: Packages installed by `platform/linux/scripts/bootstrap.nu`. Each package is installed with the first manager in priority order that has an entry for it.

managers.description: Package managers and how to drive them.

packages.description: Packages to install, keyed by a distro independent name.

managerName.description: Name of a manager defined under `managers`. Keep in sync with the manifest, `bootstrap.nu` reports mismatches.

distroName.description: Name of a distro defined under `distros`. Keep in sync with the manifest, `bootstrap.nu` reports mismatches.

match.description: Values of `ID` / `ID_LIKE` from `/etc/os-release` that select this distro.

managers.description: Managers available on this distro in default priority order. Managers are processed in this order, so a manager may only require packages provided by managers listed before it.

install.description: Install command. `{pkgs}` installs a batch of packages at once, `{pkg}` runs the command once per package.

requires.description: Package keys that must be installed before this manager is used.

check.description: When this command succeeds `setup` is skipped.

setup.description: Command run once before the first install with this manager.

refresh.description: Command run after any of the manager's repos were enabled.

repos.description: Named repositories, enabled only when a selected package references them.

check.description: When this command succeeds the repository is considered enabled.

entry.description: How the package is installed with this manager: `true` uses the package key as the name, a string is the package name, a mapping allows extra options.

name.description: Package name for this manager, defaults to the package key.

repo.description: Repository (or list of repositories) from `managers.<manager>.repos` to enable first.

check.description: When this command succeeds the package is considered installed.

run.description: Command used instead of the manager's `install`.

scriptEntry.description: Shell command that installs the package.

check.description: When this command succeeds the package is considered installed.

prefer.description: Managers to try first, overriding the distro order. A manager or list applies to every distro, a mapping sets it per distro.

package.description: Package sources per manager. Packages without a source on the current distro are reported and skipped.
